scope: Replace Dovekie by the1580-row marginal noncalibrator Pantheon+SH0ES factor; withhold all77 calibrator values from the target posterior. Predict that withheld block conditional on the observed noncalibrator rows using all published cross-covariance. No separate H0/Cepheid or overlapping SN factor.
equations: A=C_CN C_NN^-1; b=1_C-A1_N; aN=1_N^T C_NN^-1 1_N; V0=C_CC-A C_NC; V=V0+bb^T/aN; t=rC-A rN-b MhatN. logL_full_flatM=logL_N_flatM+logNormal(t;0,V). For the common calibrated-block offset, g=1_C, v=V^-1g/(g^T V^-1g), sigma=(g^T V^-1g)^-1/2. The covariance and hence v are fixed before outcomes. A constant increase k of noncalibrator distance moduli moves t by k*1_C and the contrast by k; b only propagates latent-M uncertainty, and b=0 is permitted for SPD covariance.
parent_qualification: Fresh measurement_summary.summarize_run precedes every new calculation. Keep all current parent chains, target/data/source/version identities and native scalar records verified. All non-SN likelihoods and priors cancel unchanged.
child_qualification: Unchanged luminosity-sensitivity-design.json overlap_gates, all2000 points and four chains; untrimmed exact native/proposal plus noncalibrator-minus-Dovekie density weights. The withheld conditional density never enters these posterior weights. Failed child gates withhold posterior and predictive claims.
background: One native_thermal_parameters-adjusted CAMB background per selected point, distances at the union of original Dovekie and new1580 noncalibrator redshifts. Reconstruct the original SN density before using its stored value. No spectra or transfer functions. Original covariance is untouched; marginal subset is C_NN, never a precision subblock.
predictive_precision_rule: For each positive predictive integrand, rho is normalized w*integrand. The relative self-normalized Monte Carlo influence is rho-w; relative batch MCSE=sqrt(number_of_blocks*sample_variance(block sums of rho-w)). Also calculate independent-chain relative MCSE=sqrt(4*sample_variance(chain sums of rho-w)); require both the chain estimate and all within-chain batch estimates to satisfy the same0.2 limit. A chain-constant integrand discrepancy must not gain spurious precision by subdividing each chain. Keep at least ten selected points per batch. Assess the smaller aggregateCDF/SF tail and the proper77D joint density separately. Failure withholds that predictive number, not an otherwise qualified HF posterior. No tail smoothing, clipping or Gaussian significance conversion.
predictive_interpretation: Bayesian predictive check conditional on the released Gaussian model and CMB/BAO factorization, with calibrator values excluded from the fitted density. For the fixed common-calibration linear contrast, F=sum w*Phi(v^Tt/sigma); the equal-tail area is2min(F,1-F), not the average of component two-sided areas. The full conditional77D log predictive density has units mag^-77. Neither statistic is a calibrated frequentist significance, raw-data blind test or validation of the unresolved released covariance construction. A common brightness contrast does not test every possible residual pattern.
validation: Independent dense GLS, block conditioning and scalar-M quadrature; covariance-only fixed contrast; global-offset invariance; correct mixtureCDF ordering; immutable selection and noncalibrator-only weights; synthetic cache replay/tampering; parent failure before work. Actual release may be used with fixed synthetic positive distance vectors only to verify algebraic closure, without cosmological fits or predictive conclusions.
limits: The released noncalibrator reduction, selection and covariance were constructed upstream using shared calibration information. Holding likelihood rows out does not recreate a wholly independent raw-observation experiment. Finite overlap and predictive-contribution checks do not certify missing modes or empirical covariance accuracy. Preserve the anchored combined-sample alternative separately. No empirically identified progenitor-age correction follows.
